description: Non-material amendment to Condition 5 (Windows) of planning permission reference: P2026/1498/FUL, dated 27/10/2026, for 'Subdivision of existing residential unit to form two dwellings. Replacement of windows throughout. External alterations to include new shopfront to commercial unit with railings at first floor level, separate entrance to the additional residential unit and revised access to the rear garden. Internal refurbishment and reconfiguration throughout.' The amendments sought relate to changing the glazing thickness from 12mm to 16mm and to allow non-visible trickle vents.
decision_conditions:
Condition 5 of Planning Permission P2026/1498/FUL, dated 8/10/2026, should now be read as follows:

WINDOWS (COMPLIANCE): All replacement sash windows shall accurately replicate, in terms of material, profile and detailing, the original windows surviving to the terrace. They shall be painted timber, double-hung sash windows with a slim profile and narrow integral (not applied) glazing bars.  The glazing shall be no greater than 16mm in total thickness. No visible trickle vents or metallic/perforated spacer bars are permitted.

REASON:  In order to safeguard the special architectural interest of the building and Conservation Area.
